title: MHRC-Bench: A Multilingual Hardware Repository-Level Code Completion benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2601.03708v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance on code completion in general-purpose programming languages, but existing repository-level benchmarks focus almost exclusively on software code and largely overlook hardware description languages (HDLs). We present \textbf{MHRC-Bench}, consisting of \textbf{MHRC-Bench-Train} and \textbf{MHRC-Bench-Eval}, the first benchmark for multilingual hardware code completion at the repository level with functional evaluation. translated_title: MHRC-Bench：一个多语言硬件仓库级代码补全基准
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在通用编程语言的代码补全任务上已取得出色表现，但现有的仓库级基准几乎全部专注于软件代码，而在很大程度上忽视了硬件描述语言（HDLs）。我们提出了MHRC-Bench，由MHRC-Bench-Train和MHRC-Bench-Eval组成，这是首个具备功能评估的多语言硬件仓库级代码补全基准。MHRC-Bench涵盖三种主要的硬件设计编码风格，并基于具体语法树（CST）分析，为每个补全目标标注了代码结构层面和面向硬件的语义标签。在MHRC-Bench-Train上对十亿级规模的代码LLMs进行后训练，使得较小的开源权重模型在相同上下文窗口条件下能够超越规模大得多的通用模型。除了总体准确率之外，我们的分析还揭示了四项发现（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个具备功能评估的多语言硬件仓库级代码补全基准MHRC-Bench，通过基于语法树分析的语义标注进行后训练，使小型开源代码模型能够超越更大规模的通用模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MHRC-Bench, the first repository-level multilingual hardware code completion benchmark with functional evaluation, where CST-based semantic annotations and post-training enable smaller open-weight code models to outperform much larger general-purpose models.
